zh.headline: 你好，我是 Roy。
zh.identity: 写下判断，也记录判断被证据改变的过程。
zh.intro: 这里是我的个人博客。我写 AI、具身智能、产品与创业：一项技术能做什么，用户为什么需要它，以及把它做成产品时要面对哪些取舍。
zh.essays_intro: 几篇代表文章。前两篇最好进入，后两篇是更长期的判断。

essays.title: 摄影机器人正在爆发，但还没人回答：为什么相机一定要会走？

essays.title: 当软件的消费者变成 Agent
essays.description: 软件被发现、选择和使用的方式变了，计量也需要跟着改变。

essays.title: AI Native 之后，产品的基本单位变了
essays.description: 当意图、任务与结果成为核心，产品应该如何重新组织？

zh.contact_intro: 过去近十年，我在 AI、软件与智能硬件之间做产品，也经历过几次创业。这里留下我的观察、判断，以及判断被新证据改变的过程。

en.headline: Hi, I’m Roy.
en.identity: I write down judgments — and keep a public record of the ones new evidence changes.
en.intro: This is my personal blog, about AI, embodied intelligence, products, and building companies: what technology can do, why people need it, and the choices involved in making it useful.
en.essays_intro: A few essays on the questions I keep coming back to.

essays.title: When the Software Consumer Becomes an Agent
essays.description: New ways of finding, choosing, and using software call for new ways of measuring it.

essays.title: After AI-Native: The Basic Unit of a Product Has Changed
essays.description: How products change when intent, tasks, and outcomes become central.

essays.title: Robots Give People New Bodies
essays.description: Looking at robots through the abilities and reach they give people.

essays.title: From Positional to Organizational Legitimacy
essays.description: How an appointed manager earns trust and builds cooperation.

en.projects_intro: Some questions become essays. Others become tools.
en.contact_intro: For nearly a decade, I have built products across AI, software, and intelligent hardware, with several startup chapters along the way. This blog records my observations and how new evidence changes my mind.

role.zh: Agent 计量与一致性检查

description.zh: 检查 Agent 遥测中的尝试、逻辑操作与重试是否被正确计量。每项检查返回 PASS、FAIL 或 UNPROVABLE；证据不足时明确说明。
description.en: Check whether attempts, logical operations, and retries are counted consistently in agent telemetry. Each check reports PASS, FAIL, or UNPROVABLE when evidence is missing.

evidence.zh: 相关的 token 计数修复已被 OpenLIT 合并；该修复不等于 Conformance Pack 已支持 token 检查。
evidence.en: A related token-accounting fix was merged into OpenLIT. Token checks are not yet supported by the Conformance Pack.

description.zh: 把一个研究领域整理成信源组合，持续收集内容，生成保留来源与证据边界的日报、周报和月报。
description.en: Turn a research domain into a source collection and recurring daily, weekly, and monthly digests with sources and evidence boundaries.

role.zh: 可复查的用户需求研究

description.zh: 把目标、范围与样本设计连接到需求证据和研究报告，保留来源、证据分级与反证。提供 Skill、CLI 与 MCP 接口。
description.en: Connect goals, scope, and sample design to demand evidence and research reports, preserving sources, evidence grades, and counterevidence. Available through Skill, CLI, and MCP interfaces.

description.zh: 将公开视频转换为带时间戳的 Markdown、SRT 字幕与结构化 JSON，方便检索和后续研究。
description.en: Convert public videos into timestamped Markdown, SRT subtitles, and structured JSON for searchable research.

description.zh: 按研究问题组织文章、资料与来源；提供公开全文、资料索引和面向 Agent 的只读入口。
description.en: Essays, materials, and sources organized around research questions, with public full text, material indexes, and read-only access for agents.
